title: 01 · Arrival
intent: Tsaeytte pauses at the academy entrance, looking around at the wonders on display. She is very curious about a magical raven who is regarding her.
setting: Level stone paving outside an ostentatious magic and wizardry academy.
perspective: Natural perspective, consistent character scale on the same ground plane
lighting: Soft natural daylight from the upper left
style: Painterly semi-realistic fantasy illustration, anime-influenced facial stylization, refined linework
